name: pf-mod-town-rebuild
about: mod-town-rebuild against the built packages pets, qol, town instead of the mods' source folders (tools/make_package_scenarios.py). Units HWP spawns once per town load (the gambler, the laststats notice board, the pets feeding bowl) come back after a building upgrade, which reloads the town level without a new Start (gl townrefresh = TownRecord.Refresh). No duplicates after a second rebuild. The feeding bowl is optional since 2026-10-25 (pets.bowl, default off; the pet menu lives at the Pet Shop keeper): the scenario turns it on with `hwp set pets.bowl 1`, which places it at once, so its respawn after a rebuild stays covered.

steps.name: the optional feeding bowl turned on (placed at once by OnSettingChanged)
notice board back after the rebuild
feeding bowl back after the rebuild
exactly one gambler after a second rebuild

allow: Resource name hash conflict in package 'mods/(HWP-[a-z0-9]+|HammerwatchPlus-All)(-gamelab)?\.bin' for file
